- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Victorian era saw a rise in religious revival movements, such as the evangelical movement, which emphasized personal piety and individual salvation.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] These religious movements influenced attitudes towards morality, social justice, and philanthropy.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Victorian era also witnessed the rise of secularism, with more people questioning the role of religion in society.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Despite the rise of secularism, religion continued to be a dominant force in shaping Victorian society, influencing politics, education, and social welfare.
